name: Make-A-Wish America
summary: The US federation of Make-A-Wish: a national office in Phoenix and 58 chartered chapters that grant wishes (trips, meetings with heroes, gifts, experiences) to children aged 2½ to 17 with critical illnesses, about 16,000 a year.

spending.source: https://wish.org/sites/default/files/2025-08/Annual_Report_FY24_FINAL.pdf (Annual Report fiscal 2024, p. 5, Combined Enterprise: program services $201.4M of operating expenses of $352.5M (fundraising $81.9M, management and general $69.2M), year ended 31 August 2024, national office and chapters combined, donated advertising and media excluded. Audited cross-check: the national office's statements, note 1, give the chapters' combined total expenses, $295.8M: https://wish.org/sites/default/files/2026-02/Signed%20Financial%20Statements%20FY24%20%28002%29%20%281%29.pdf)

lines.label: Wish granting by the national office and chapters (with chapter support, training and public information)
lines.source: https://wish.org/sites/default/files/2025-08/Annual_Report_FY24_FINAL.pdf (Annual Report fiscal 2024, p. 5, Combined Enterprise program services: wish granting $175.8M, chapter support $23.0M, public information $2.1M, training and development $0.5M). One line because chapter support, training and public information exist to grant wishes; the donated public-service advertising ($67.8M in the national accounts, note 2) is counted as others' resources in the model's credit share.
